production_equivalence.reused_other_gates: Prior Portal frontend format/syntax/UI contracts and direct-wheel/sdist-to-wheel/isolated imports apply to byte-identical production inputs; test reporting configuration is new and validated separately.

runtime_identity.root_cause: A short close may finish before the owned draining publication. The old test polled read_private during atomic replacement; the production guard correctly rejected an identity change between file inspection and final path verification.
runtime_identity.change: Join that instance's actual draining publication with a5s observation ceiling before reading; preserve short close, lock, readiness, eventual close and next-boot assertions. No production read retry or identity-check relaxation.

controls.method: Execute the exact original function; gate the real owned writer and trigger its atomic replacement after the read stream closes but before final path inspection. The current test releases/joins the same publication before reading. No file bytes or success response are fabricated.
